source.base_subject: bench: select Decode FP8 output sidecar
source.benchmark_note: The production benchmark candidate is a descendant worktree of the test-only selection. The final validation binary adds noexcept and memory-headroom exception-path repairs; its hot-path sidecar dispatch and kernel are unchanged.

environment.clock_scope: sysfs min/max/current readbacks establish the requested fixed-frequency state, not thermal or power stability

implementation.phase: Decode M1, plus final-prompt C1 delegation when it reaches the same exact projection route
implementation.canonical_route: production codebook-swizzled row-quad kernel capped at 1280 CTAs
implementation.sidecar_route: AoSoA4 row-quad and packed-word layout with each FP8 byte pretransformed as code^(code>>5), fixed at 1024 CTAs
implementation.preparation: one GPU pack launch per layer during model construction on a private nonblocking stream, synchronized before runner construction
implementation.ownership: one persistent RAII arena attached atomically to all 64 exact-shape output projections
implementation.admission: SM87 only; preserve the configured 8-GiB post-create free-memory margin
implementation.failure_policy: memory-headroom or allocation pressure falls back to canonical weights; pack launch, synchronization, or attachment failure fails construction
implementation.runtime_buffering_scope: persistent weight-format sidecar only; this is not a request double/triple buffer, cross-kernel overlap, Prefill/Decode overlap, or multi-request scheduler

formal_kernel_and_pack_gate.history_note: The earlier production-candidate formal log at SHA-256 0e014cf5e0f94825cd57484e9d90ccef869a3cdf88489ac3281e003e1e6d02a4 measured 0.188994/0.176769 ms actual and 0.168544/0.162100 ms stress. It remains historical selection evidence; the Release log above is authoritative for production promotion.

workload.prompt: 用一句话解释 CUDA 是什么。
workload.normalized_command: BINARY benchmark MODEL_DIR --prompt '用一句话解释 CUDA 是什么。' --max-tokens 26 --warmup 1 --iterations 5 --max-sequence-length 64 --projection-backend sm87 --prefill-chunk-size 32

mirrored_aggregate.method: arithmetic mean of the two process medians on each side

decision.result: promote exact FP8 M1 output-projection AoSoA4/preswizzled sidecar to production SM87 dispatch
decision.next_priority: screen the bounded Decode NVFP4 down CTA-prune candidate, then capture a fresh production Decode profile and re-rank remaining phase-local hotspots
decision.prefill_policy: resume the much larger Prefill program after the incremental single-request Decode target is met

limitations: The 109.7585-ms/token result is hot single-request Decode on the named P19/C32/max26 workload; it excludes model load and sidecar construction.
The production choice consumes 1.875 GiB of persistent device memory and adds about 467 ms mean cold sidecar construction in the two benchmark candidate processes.
The 9.1109 token/s value is the reciprocal of the mirrored hot subsequent-token median; it is not multi-request serving throughput.

The final validation binary differs from the timed candidate by noexcept and memory-headroom exception-path repairs. Exact model replay passed on that final binary, but the B-C-C-B timing was not repeated on it.
This record includes no fresh post-promotion Nsys or NCU attribution, power, energy, thermal-soak, long-context, multi-request, or tail-latency claim.
Prefill and Decode remain logically separate but causally serialized for one batch-one request; the persistent weight sidecar does not add general double/triple buffering.
